title: vicia calcarata var. cinerea
intro: Vicia calcarata var. cinerea, commonly known as Hoary Vetch, is a perennial legume plant species. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include being a natural remedy for various conditions due to its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hoary Vetch include treating skin issues, wounds, and gastrointestinal problems. The bioactive constituents of Hoary Vetch include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
